items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: Lurlean Hunter one of the greatest singers that Carmen McRae was in awe of.

ctx.x: Chris Anderson. He said Herbie Hancock studied with him. A harmonic genius. And he came up with Bill Lee who was another genius, who was Spike Lee’s father, that’s the way I could put it, no people know about Bill Lee too much but he’s Spike Lee’s father. Harmonic genius. He was the one that taught me how to play music. Because when I heard him play in Chicago he was playing these chords and I said wow man, what kind of stuff is that? Now you had got away from Phineas playing, you know the two hands and swinging…

that is. You know. So it took me two weeks before he would open up to me and he showed me, he talked to me about what he was doing, then he told me about Chris Anderson and Billy Wallace and naturally Mr. Ahmad Jamal was holding court at the Persian Lounge another harmonic genius, a true musical genius. I mean everybody knows how I feel about Ahmad and Phineas, that those are my two favorite piano players bar none, and they don’t have a problem with it, you see what I’m saying. But back to about the singers,…
